segments.text:
V. 31.
Then come his brethren and his mother—Having at length made their Way through the Croud, ſo as to come to the Door. His Brethren are here named firſt, as being firſt and moſt earneſt in the Deſign of taking Him: For neither did theſe of his brethren believe on him. They ſent to him, calling him—They ſent one into the Houſe, who called Him aloud, by Name.
